text:
sam_platform: Prototype: SLO-conscious recompute UX landed in staging. Key idea: let users schedule small, prioritized recomputes ('mini-runs') that surface ETA, cost estimate, and route hints (dedicated vs hosted burst vs quantized). Need quick input on routing semantics + quota charging. figma: https://figma.com/proto/mini-recompute (mock)
anya: Nice. How are we computing ETA? shard count? data bytes? need something explainable to customers.
felix: Routing thoughts: prefer dedicated pools when tenant has reserved capacity, fall back to hosted-burst, then to cheaper quantized model if capacity constrained. But we need clear audit/log + permission model. Also billing question: do we bill from reserved commit or host usage?
maria: UI idea: show a progress/confidence bar and a small 'cost vs speed' toggle. Only admins should be able to force 'use dedicated'.
sam_platform: ETA prototype uses: ETA = sum(shard_bytes / shard_throughput_profile) * 1.15 (95th pct multiplier). Will paste pseudo later.
anya: We should tag runs that rewrite past aggregates as 'data-delta risk' and offer a dry-run to preview deltas before commit.
felix: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/recompute
{
  "scope": "tenant:123:metric:agg-hours",
  "priority": "slo",
  "route_hint": "dedicated|hosted-burst|quantized",
  "dry_run": true,
  "cost_limit_cents": 20000
}
```
maria: For streaming progress: can we emit per-shard heartbeat to /v1/recompute/progress? telemetry team: will that flood the event bus?
sam_platform: We'll batch progress and sample for large runs. For >500 shards we'll emit aggregate percent + top-5 failing shards only.
deploy-bot: deploy status: recompute-prototype-ui v0.3 deployed to staging — https://ci/release/987
anya: I'll smoke-test with EU agg sample. Also: quota accounting — we already have recompute_quota token buckets per-tenant.
felix: Proposal for quota: two-tier model. 1) reserve slots from recompute_slot_pool for scheduled runs (predictable throughput). 2) ad-hoc runs consume burst_quota with a higher cost multiplier. Admins set tenant cap.
maria: UX: if estimate > tenant budget show suggested adjustments: reduce parallelism, use quantized model, or narrow date range.
sam_platform: Rollout plan: (1) internal staging + internal tenants (2) opt-in flag per-tenant (3) 10% canary in prod (4) ramp. Need SRE signoff on routing/fallback behavior.
anya: SRE input: I'll add alerts: recompute runtime > ETA + 2h triggers pager. Also need observability tile: per-tenant ETA variance and cost burn.
felix: Important: when we auto-fallback from dedicated -> hosted, do NOT silently switch billing model. Emit an audit event and show a post-run billing summary.
maria: Can we offer a 'preview diff' modal that runs a 24h sample recompute to show percent-change for the affected aggregates before full run?
sam_platform: Good call — will add dry_run preview modal. I'll open RFC PR with API spec + console mocks. Looking for pairing on cost calc. @felix @anya want to pair tomorrow 11am PT?
felix: I can do 11am PT.
anya: I'll join for drift-risk modelling.
sam_platform: Follow-ups I'll file: PR api/rfc/recompute-slo.json, task telemetry/sampling-config, ui/dry-run-modal. Posting links when ready. :rocket:
maria: :thumbsup:
